steps: Rinse the poha in a strainer two or three times, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften.
Sprinkle the salt, sugar and turmeric over it and mix lightly with your fingers.
Heat the oil in a pan, let the mustard seeds pop, then add the cumin and a pinch of hing.
Fry the onion and green chilli until the onion turns soft and see-through.
Add the small potato cubes, cover, and cook on low heat until tender.
Add the poha and toss gently so it mixes without breaking.
Cover and steam on very low heat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Squeeze lemon over it, scatter coriander leaves and serve hot.
note: The sources used 47 to 71 g of dry poha a serving, and 60 g makes a full breakfast plate. Potato is optional in one source and fried in the other; it is kept as it makes the dish more filling.
